review.description: Adopt the existing S1 subscription verification/filtering, S2 bounded retry/progress behavior and explicit S3 real-host blocker at the fixed fourteen-flow initial baseline. Transport/429/server failures retry under eight failed attempts; gone disables, other failures/exhaustion advance, and notification-disabled processing skips events without later replay. Public source publication replaces personal operator details with installation-neutral documentation, omits private evidence/history, and retains the same scope of existing runtime assertions; hosted verification uses fixtures only.
review.implementation: Inspected events.Tick: the delivery match includes config.Notifications; cursor advancement still occurs for nonmatching/disabled events. Failed delivery increments attempts; 410 disables, only transport/429/server failures below the attempt limit retain retry state, otherwise progress advances/reset occurs. These existing outcomes are described without changing product code. Public source publication replaces personal operator details with installation-neutral documentation, omits private evidence/history, and retains the same scope of existing runtime assertions; hosted verification uses fixtures only.
review.tests: Read TestSubscriptionVerificationRetryDedupRefreshAndExpiry: signature/duplicate/filter handling and one HTTP503 retry preserve event identity; expiry and idempotent unsubscribe are asserted. Dedicated transport/429/permanent/410/exhaustion/disabled-no-replay, changed-key refresh, restart and post-unsubscribe no-delivery assertions remain gaps. Real-host subscriptions/callbacks remain blocked; fixture success does not close S3.
